subject: Model family consolidation: migration lane requests & timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: jane.doe@acme-retail.com, platform-team@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Model family consolidation: migration lane requests & timeline

Team —

Quick summary: product has finalized the plan to consolidate the X-family models (x-large-v1 / x-large-v1-quant) into the new unitary endpoint x-unified-v1. This will reduce maintenance surface and improve throughput, but it requires coordinated cutover for customers who rely on the legacy variants or have strict accuracy/regulatory requirements.

As owners across product, sales, ops, research and legal, we need a compact migration lane plan and a short list of potential exceptions. Please review and answer the three asks below by end-of-day Friday so I can lock the timeline for external comms:

1) Migration lane ownership: who will own lane A (enterprise customers requiring no behavior change), lane B (customers who accept small delta but need validation), lane C (strict non-breaking with custom shim) — name owners and one backup.
2) Risk/exception candidates: list any accounts that must be exempted or receive a bespoke rollout, with reason (SLA, certification, feature parity).
3) Blockers & timeline impacts: list infra or product blockers and an ETA to resolve (if known).

I attached a starting migration_matrix.xlsx with suggested mappings — please edit directly and flag any cells you want to discuss.

Marissa
Product Lead, API Experience
Redwood Inference

[attachment: migration_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model family consolidation: migration lane requests & timeline

Marissa — thanks for the clear asks. A few notes from GTM/customer side: 

- Acme Retail is on lane A today but they have a pending SOC-2 audit in September and asked for an explicit validation window and a rollback plan. They flagged latency sensitivity on peak hours.
- I think we should mark Acme as a "soft-exception" until we provide a 2-week canary with performance reports.
- I'll own lane B for west-coast retail accounts; backup: Rishi.

I'll update the migration_matrix with Acme rows and add the customer point-of-contact. Also attaching the partial exception log we've been using in renewals.

— Aditya

Folks — infra constraints:

- We need kernel/quant runtime parity for x-unified-v1 on the dedicated fleet. The compilation team estimates this is a 3-week effort to certify (INF-4721).
- Autoscaling memory pressure with legacy kv-cache shims could cause a 10–15% latency spike until we ship a cache-eviction optimization patch. ETA for patch: 10 business days if we prioritize.
- Canary capacity: we can run a canary for up to 2 lane-A customers with full telemetry starting next Monday, but we need explicit sign-off on data retention for the telemetry buckets (Laura, heads up).

I'll flag the INF ticket in the doc and add the runtime parity ETA.

— Ben

Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model family consolidation: migration lane requests & timeline

Notes from research on model delta and fallback: 

- We ran a 5000-example regression test between x-large-v1 and x-unified-v1 on representative retail prompts: average generation BLEU-style delta is small (~0.7%), but we see edge cases in product-title parsing where the unified model rewrites entities. Recommend: the lane C shim preserves entity-anchoring by keeping a short prefix KG in the prompt for affected customers.
- Quantization parity: x-unified-v1-quant is slightly noisier; if customers are running 4-bit quant, we should offer a 16-bit compatible fallback for lane C until we complete additional calibration.

Will add these technical notes and recommended mitigations to the document. I'm happy to pair with Ben on the canary telemetry payload to show parity metrics.

— Monica
Applied ML / Inference Research
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 12:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model family consolidation: migration lane requests & timeline

Quick legal/compliance notes:

- For customers under active audits (Acme included), we should provide a written validation package: test matrix, telemetry summary, rollback instructions, and DPA acknowledgement. That package needs Legal sign-off before external comms.
- If any customer requires data residency or contractual variant constraints, flag now — we will need a written exception with duration and owner.
- Telemetry retention for canaries: default 90 days. If Sales wants shorter retention for audit reasons, we can negotiate a covered period but need customer consent and an updated DPA amendment; this will add 2–3 weeks for legal review.

I'll prepare a validation-package template and drop in the doc.

— Laura
Head of Legal & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — consolidated status and next steps below for clarity:

Decisions / owners
- Lane A (no behavior change): Owner = Aditya Rao; backup = Rishi Malhotra
- Lane B (small delta, validation): Owner = Marissa Cole; backup = Monica Patel
- Lane C (non-breaking shim): Owner = Ben Carter; backup = Monica Patel

Exceptions

Blockers & ETAs
- Runtime/kernel parity (INF-4721): 3 weeks (Ben)
- Cache-eviction latency patch: 10 business days (Ben)
- Legal DPA amendment for telemetry: 2–3 weeks (Laura)

Action items (owners & deadlines)
- Aditya: update migration_matrix and confirm Acme canary by Mon 7/16.
- Ben: prioritize INF-4721 and provide daily ETA updates into Jira.
- Monica: produce parity report for lane B by Tue 7/17.
- Laura: deliver validation-package template by Fri 7/20.
- Marissa: finalize external comms draft and send to legal for review by Fri 7/20.

I'll set a 30-minute sync next Tuesday to review the canary plan and make any lane reassignments if needed. If you see missing rows in the doc, edit in place and ping me.

Marissa

Redwood Inference
